subject: Account expansion: billing onboarding, PO number & tax docs
messages:
From: Lara Gomez <lara@latticeai.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@latticeai.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Expansion PO and billing contact for Redwood expansion

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note — we're ramping the pilot to a paid capacity next quarter and Procurement asked me to loop you in for next steps. Can you confirm:
- Is Redwood able to accept a PO (we'll issue a standard company PO)?
- What billing contact/email should Procurement put on the PO?
- Do you need a W-9 or other tax form from us?

We expect initial committed capacity to increase by ~2.5x (estimate attached in the SOW). We'd like to lock pricing and confirm net terms (they typically work net45).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Lara
Head of Ops, LatticeAI

Attachment: pilot-sow-summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Gomez <lara@latticeai.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion PO and billing contact for Redwood expansion

Hi Lara — great news, congrats on the ramp. Quick answers inline below and next steps at the end.

- PO: Yes, we accept POs. Please put the PO email to invoices@redwoodinference.com and cc finance@redwoodinference.com.
- Billing contact: invoices@redwoodinference.com (for the PO), for licensing and billing questions please cc Marissa Cole (marissa@redwoodinference.com).
- Tax form: We will need your signed PO and your company W-9 (US entity) or W-8/W8-BEN-E if non-US.

Net terms: Our standard for new capacity commitments is net30, but we can accommodate net45 on an account-level exception for committed annual contracts. Ben/Marissa — can you confirm which term we can offer under RDW-4721?

Next steps:
1) If Procurement confirms net45 we will add that to the order and provide an invoice schedule.
2) I will send a DocuSign for the order form and attach Redwood W-9 for your records.
3) Once we have PO + signed order form, Finance will queue the invoice.

If you want, I'll get a brief calendar for Monday to finalize.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion PO and billing contact for Redwood expansion

Jasmine — jumping in. For RDW-4721 we can support net45 if the customer commits to 12-month reserved capacity or an annual prepay schedule. If they're doing month-to-month expansion, Finance prefers net30.

Marissa, please confirm the invoice owner and whether we need a billing contact @redwoodinference to be listed differently for PO processing (we've had cases where the PO payor entity differs).

Ben
Director, Sales Ops

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Expansion PO and billing contact for Redwood expansion

Ben/Team — confirmed. Finance will accept net45 for this deal (RDW-4721) provided:
- Signed order form or DocuSign record is present;
- PO references legal entity Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 27-XXXXXXX);
- We receive LatticeAI's W-9 (or W-8 if non-US) prior to first invoice.

Invoice owner: invoices@redwoodinference.com (AP desk). Billing contact for collection questions: marissa@redwoodinference.com.

I'll attach Redwood's W-9 and the standard invoice instructions PDF to the outgoing email.

Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf, Invoice_Instructions_RDW.pdf

Hi Lara — thanks for the quick reply earlier. Per Finance we've confirmed net45 for RDW-4721 contingent on the signed order form and W-9. I've started the DocuSign for the order form (link below) and attached Redwood's W-9 and invoice instructions for Procurement.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcdef-123456

Please have Procurement:
- Send PO to invoices@redwoodinference.com and include the PO number on the DocuSigned order form or reply to this thread with the PO number;
- Attach/return your company's W-9 (PDF) when you submit the PO.

I'll queue the first invoice after we have both items. If Procurement needs a standard PO template or additional fields (ship-to, remit-to), let me know and I can send a PO fill template.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if that speeds things up.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W9_2026.pdf, Invoice_Instructions_RDW.pdf
